control_scope: R1/R2 descriptive only; no frozen pass criterion or rescue of R3.
limitations: One pinned model/sampler, finite detached three-action views, two opaque families and12 schedules per relation/family.
Same-seed pairs improve control; this is bounded behavioral invariance, not proof of internal feature use or statistical independence.
R1/R2 are descriptive controls without registered support thresholds; they cannot rescue R3.
No actual world outcomes, authenticated Memory, learning, causal inference or closed-loop performance is measured.
Runtime guards are trusted in-process checks, not hostile-code isolation or cryptographic attestation.
